intervals.quote: Data-taking started in January 1979 by the detectors MARK J, PLUTO and TASSO.

placements.note: Campus-grade placement: DESY published no coordinates for the PETRA experimental halls that were fetched; the marker is the DESY campus point.
placements.quote: Mark-J, PLUTO, TASSO detectors moved into beam

summary.plain: The MARK J particle detector at one of the four collision regions of DESY's PETRA ring, used to measure how the energy of e+e- collisions was shared among the produced particles.
summary.technical: MARK J detector at PETRA (1979-1986); its 1979 energy-flow analysis introduced the 'oblateness' variable to expose three-jet structure. A published detector description was not retrieved for this record.
